text:
Summarize the following in two sentences:
The city council voted 7-4 to approve the transit levy after a three-hour hearing. Opponents argued the levy disproportionately affects outer-ring homeowners, while supporters pointed to a projected 18% increase in bus frequency. Implementation begins in the next fiscal year.

Condense this email thread to three bullet points:
Sam: The vendor missed the integration deadline again.
Ria: Third time. Their PM says the auth layer is blocking.
Sam: We have a hard cutover on the 14th.
Ria: I suggest we escalate to their director and prepare a fallback.

Write a one-paragraph summary of this abstract:
We evaluated four irrigation schedules across two growing seasons. Deficit irrigation reduced water use by 22% with no significant yield loss in year one, but a 9% loss in year two, which was drier. Results suggest deficit scheduling is viable only where seasonal rainfall exceeds 400mm.

Summarize the customer's core complaint in one sentence:
"I've been a subscriber for four years. The new interface hides the export button, and after twenty minutes I gave up and used a competitor's tool. I don't want a tutorial, I want the button back."

Give me a two-sentence executive summary of this incident report:
At 03:12 UTC a config push removed a firewall rule, exposing the staging database to the public internet for 41 minutes. No unauthorized access was recorded in audit logs. The rule was restored manually and the deploy pipeline now blocks firewall changes without a second approver.

Reduce this to under 50 words:
The pilot programme placed nurse practitioners in six rural clinics. Wait times fell from an average of eleven days to four. Patient satisfaction rose modestly. Costs per visit increased 8% due to travel stipends, though the programme office argues avoided emergency visits offset this.

Summarize the key findings only, in three bullets:
Survey of 1,200 remote workers. 68% report better focus at home. 41% report worse collaboration. 22% say they would take a pay cut to stay remote. Managers report no measurable change in delivery velocity.

Write a short summary of what changed in this release note:
v3.4 adds bulk export, fixes a timezone bug in scheduled reports, deprecates the legacy /v1 endpoint, and improves dashboard load time by roughly 30%.

In two sentences, summarize the argument being made:
Critics of the proposal focus on cost, but the cost objection assumes the current system is free to maintain. Once deferred maintenance is priced in, the proposal is cheaper over ten years, though more expensive in the first three.

Summarize this meeting transcript excerpt in under 40 words:
We agreed to delay the launch two weeks. Marketing keeps the current creative. Engineering uses the time for the migration. Legal still needs to review the terms page. Next check-in Thursday.

Classify this ticket as one of: BILLING, BUG, FEATURE_REQUEST, ACCOUNT. Label only.
"The export button does nothing when I click it in Safari."

Classify as one of: BILLING, BUG, FEATURE_REQUEST, ACCOUNT.
"Can you add a dark mode? My eyes hurt after long sessions."

Classify as one of: BILLING, BUG, FEATURE_REQUEST, ACCOUNT.
"I need to transfer ownership of the workspace to my colleague."

Label the sentiment of this review as POSITIVE, NEGATIVE, or MIXED:
"Fast delivery and the product is well made, but the instructions were useless."

Label the sentiment as POSITIVE, NEGATIVE, or MIXED:
"Exactly what I needed, arrived early, would buy again."

Is this message URGENT or ROUTINE?
"Production is down for all EU customers, error rate 100%."

Categorize this expense into one of: TRAVEL, SOFTWARE, MEALS, EQUIPMENT.
"Annual license renewal for the design tool, 480 USD."

Categorize into one of: TRAVEL, SOFTWARE, MEALS, EQUIPMENT.
"Standing desk and monitor arm for the new hire."

Assign one topic label from: PRICING, ONBOARDING, INTEGRATIONS, SECURITY.
"How do we get SSO working with our Okta tenant?"

Choose one: SPAM or LEGITIMATE.
"Your package could not be delivered. Confirm your card details at this link to reschedule."

Label the intent as one of: CANCEL, UPGRADE, QUESTION, COMPLAINT.
"We're growing and need more seats before the end of the month."

Is this feedback about PERFORMANCE, USABILITY, or RELIABILITY?
"The app crashes about once a day, usually when I switch projects."

Classify the reading level of this passage as ELEMENTARY, INTERMEDIATE, or ADVANCED:
"The mitochondrion generates most of the cell's supply of adenosine triphosphate through oxidative phosphorylation."

Tag this job posting as ENGINEERING, SALES, DESIGN, or OPERATIONS:
"You will own our warehouse throughput metrics and vendor SLAs across three fulfilment centres."
Given these numbers, state which region grew fastest and by what percentage. North: 220 to 268. South: 410 to 470. West: 95 to 120.
From this data, report the mean and the outlier: 42, 39, 44, 41, 96, 40, 43.

List the three most frequent error types in this log summary, in order:
timeout: 219, auth_failed: 12, timeout: 88, rate_limited: 140, parse_error: 31, rate_limited: 22
Given monthly churn of 3.1%, 2.8%, 3.4%, 4.0%, describe the trend in one sentence and give the average.
Produce a JSON object with keys total, average, and max from these order values: 120, 85, 340, 60, 215.
Compare these two plans in a two-column markdown table: Basic ($9, 3 seats, email support) and Pro ($29, 15 seats, priority support, SSO).

Given this schedule, identify any conflicts:
09:00-10:00 Standup (Room A)
09:30-10:30 Design review (Room A)
11:00-12:00 1:1 (Room B)

Which of these three candidates has the most relevant experience for a backend role, based only on the lines below? Answer with the name and one clause of justification.
A: 6 years Django, 2 years Postgres tuning.
B: 8 years frontend React, some Node scripts.
C: 3 years Go microservices, 1 year Kubernetes.

Summarize this survey result as a percentage breakdown by category:
Satisfied: 412, Neutral: 188, Dissatisfied: 100

From the transcript below, extract every action item with its owner as a bulleted list.
Ria will send the vendor contract by Friday. Sam is updating the runbook. Nobody has picked up the pricing page copy yet.

Rewrite this message to be more polite without changing its meaning:
"You didn't send the file again. I need it now."

Rewrite this for a non-technical audience:
"The service returns a 429 when the client exceeds the per-minute token bucket allocation."

Make this paragraph more concise without losing any facts:
It is important to note that, at this point in time, we are currently in the process of evaluating a number of different options with respect to the vendor selection process.

Rewrite this job description bullet in active voice:
"Responsibility for the maintenance of the reporting pipeline will be held by the successful candidate."

Turn this into a formal one-sentence apology to a customer:
"yeah we messed up the shipping thing, sorry about that"

Rewrite these notes as three complete sentences:
- server migration done
- two dashboards still broken
- fix ETA next week

Translate this into plain English:
"Pursuant to section 4.2, the licensee shall indemnify the licensor against any third-party claims arising from misuse."
Shorten this subject line to under 8 words: "Following up regarding the outstanding invoice from the month of March that remains unpaid"

Extract every date and what happened on it, as JSON array of {date, event}:
The contract was signed on 4 March, the deposit cleared on 11 March, and delivery slipped to 2 April.
Build a JSON object of the specifications listed here: 15-inch display, 16GB RAM, 512GB SSD, 1.4kg, two USB-C ports.

From this résumé fragment, output roles as JSON with company, title, and years.
Northgate Ltd, Senior Analyst, 2019-2022. Vellum, Data Lead, 2022-present.

Given this paragraph, list each risk mentioned and mark it HIGH or LOW based on the language used:
"Supplier concentration is a serious concern. Currency exposure is minor. Regulatory change could be material."
Parse this address into JSON fields street, city, region, postcode: 12 Rue de Berri, Paris, Ile-de-France, 75008

In under 60 words, what is the main difference between these two policies?
Policy A: refunds within 30 days, no questions asked.
Policy B: refunds within 90 days, restocking fee of 15%.

Which of these two error messages is more actionable for a user, and why in one sentence?
(1) "An error occurred."
(2) "Upload failed: file exceeds the 25MB limit."

Given these two summaries of the same article, state which is more faithful in one sentence.
A: "The study found deficit irrigation saves water with no yield cost."
B: "The study found deficit irrigation saves water, with yield losses in dry years."

Compare the tone of these two replies in one sentence each:
(1) "We cannot accommodate that."
(2) "That isn't something we can do right now, but here's an alternative."

What is the customer's emotional state in this message? One sentence.
"This is the fourth time I've written. Nobody has replied. I don't know what else to do."

Rate the urgency of this message on a 1-5 scale and give the number only:
"Whenever you get a chance, could you look at the font on the pricing page?"

Does this review indicate the customer will churn? Answer yes/no and one clause of reasoning.
"Still using it, but I've started trialling two alternatives."

Give a two-sentence summary of this policy change:
Starting in July, expense reports over 200 EUR require a receipt image. Reports under 200 EUR remain self-attested. The finance team will audit 5% of self-attested reports monthly.

Classify this code comment as TODO, WARNING, or EXPLANATION:
"# NOTE: this assumes the input is already sorted; callers must guarantee it"
Given these test results, report the pass rate as a percentage and name the failing suite. auth: 40/40, billing: 18/22, search: 61/61.

Rewrite this alert text to be under 15 words and still specific:
"The background job that synchronises customer records with the CRM has failed to complete successfully."

Summarize the disagreement between these two comments in one sentence:
Dev A: "We should cache aggressively, reads dominate."
Dev B: "Cache invalidation will bite us; correctness first."

From this text, output a JSON list of every numeric metric with its label:
Revenue grew 12% to 4.4M while headcount rose from 38 to 45 and churn held at 3.1%.

Assign one of: APPROVED, NEEDS_INFO, REJECTED.
"Application is complete and meets all stated criteria; income verified."

Assign one of: APPROVED, NEEDS_INFO, REJECTED.
"Applicant did not include proof of address; everything else checks out."

In three bullets, summarize what a new team member needs to know from this note:
Deploys happen Tuesdays and Thursdays. The staging database is wiped nightly. Never merge to main without a green CI run and one approval.
Given this budget line, state whether it is over or under and by how much: allocated 12,000, spent 13,450.

Convert this passive support macro into a direct, friendly reply:
"The refund has been processed by our team and should be received by the customer within 5 days."
Which option is cheaper over 12 months and by how much? A: 29/month. B: 300/year.

Summarize this changelog entry for a non-technical stakeholder, one sentence:
"Replaced the N+1 query in the invoice list view with a single joined query and added an index on invoices.customer_id."

Label this as FACT or OPINION:
"The new dashboard loads in under a second on our test machines."

Label this as FACT or OPINION:
"The new dashboard is the best thing we've shipped all year."

List each requirement in this sentence as a separate bullet:
The form must validate the email, reject disposable domains, and store consent with a timestamp.
